shortDescription: Text to speech module for Windows to speak messages and optionally play sounds

options.name: end_sound_path
options.description: Full path to a C(.wav) file containing a sound to play after the text has been spoken. Useful on conference calls to alert other speakers that ansible has finished speaking.

options.name: msg
options.description: The text to be spoken. Use either C(msg) or C(msg_file). Optional so that you can use this module just to play sounds.

options.name: msg_file
options.description: Full path to a windows format text file containing the text to be spoken. Use either C(msg) or C(msg_file). Optional so that you can use this module just to play sounds.

options.name: speech_speed
options.description: How fast or slow to speak the text. Must be an integer value in the range -10 to 10. -10 is slowest, 10 is fastest.

options.name: start_sound_path
options.description: Full path to a C(.wav) file containing a sound to play before the text is spoken. Useful on conference calls to alert other speakers that ansible has something to say.

options.name: voice
options.description: Which voice to use. See notes for how to discover installed voices. If the requested voice is not available the default voice will be used. Example voice names from Windows 10 are C(Microsoft Zira Desktop) and C(Microsoft Hazel Desktop).
